title: 【MD Official】Marvelous Designer 2022 User Communication Conference p02 Part Two_Substance Painter Texturing Process - Cino
description:
Hello everyone, on January 8, 2022, we held the User Exchange Conference for 2022 in the afternoon.  
This conference consisted of three main parts: the production of steampunk costumes, Substance material texture creation (speaker: Cino), and how to quickly create a coat in MD and subsequently import it into Maya for modifications (speaker: Johnny Xiao).  
We welcome everyone to join our QQ group (follow the account or send a private message to receive the group number and password automatically!).
